meta.name: diffdock
meta.description: DiffDock and DiffDock-L molecular docking. Use for protein-small-molecule pose prediction from PDB or sequence plus SMILES/SDF/MOL2, batch docking, virtual screening, and pose-confidence interpretation. Not for binding affinity prediction.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测蛋白质与小分子的结合构象
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是从事药物设计或结构生物学的科研人员
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a researcher in drug design or structural biology

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可用 DiffDock 进行蛋白质-小分子对接：从 PDB 或氨基酸序列及配体文件/SMILES 预测 3D 结合构象，输出带置信度分数的排名构象，并支持批量对接和虚拟筛选。
howto.when: 当用户提出“对接”、“预测结合构象”、“虚拟筛选”等分子对接相关需求，或提供蛋白质结构和配体信息时触发。

say.text: 用 DiffDock 对接这个配体和这个蛋白，输出前几个构象。
say.note: 执行单分子对接并显示排名构象。

say.text: 用这个 CSV 做批量对接和虚拟筛选。
分析这些对接结果的置信度并导出 CSV。
say.note: 调用分析脚本生成统计摘要。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can run DiffDock for protein-ligand docking: predict 3D binding poses from PDB or sequence with ligand files/SMILES, output ranked poses with confidence scores, and support batch docking and virtual screening.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for docking, pose prediction, or virtual screening, or provides a protein structure and ligand information.

say_en.text: Use DiffDock to dock this ligand to this protein and show top poses.
say_en.note: Runs single-complex docking and outputs ranked poses.

say_en.text: Run batch docking and virtual screening from this CSV.
Analyze confidence scores from these results and export to CSV.
say_en.note: Calls the analysis script to generate statistics.
